# The Project Shop

> B.Tech Final Year Engineering Projects in IoT, Robotics & Software, Electronic Components & Hands-On DIY Kits.

The Project Shop (https://www.theprojectshop.online/) provides end-to-end project development, prototyping, and support for B.Tech engineering students across India, alongside an electronics store for components, development boards, and DIY kits.

## Contact & Direct Access
- **Official Contact Email:** theprojectstoreonline@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.theprojectshop.online/
- **Full Knowledge Base for AI Agents:** https://www.theprojectshop.online/llms-full.txt
- **Sitemap:** https://www.theprojectshop.online/sitemap.xml
- **Human Credits:** https://www.theprojectshop.online/humans.txt

## Core Offerings

- [Final Year Projects](https://www.theprojectshop.online/): Customized and turnkey B.Tech capstone projects for engineering students in IoT, Robotics, Embedded Systems, and Software.
- [IoT Systems](https://www.theprojectshop.online/): Sensor integration, microcontrollers (ESP32, STM32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi), MQTT protocols, and cloud IoT dashboards.
- [Robotics](https://www.theprojectshop.online/): Autonomous rovers, robotic arms, obstacle-avoidance machines, drones, and motor driver circuits.
- [Software Applications](https://www.theprojectshop.online/): Full-stack web applications, mobile applications, computer vision, AI/ML models, and embedded firmware.
- [Electronic Components](https://www.theprojectshop.online/): Microcontrollers, sensors, actuators, motor drivers, communication modules, power electronics, and development boards.
- [DIY Kits & PCB Prototypes](https://www.theprojectshop.online/): Curated electronics kits for hands-on learning, custom PCB design, rapid prototyping, and assembly.

## Details

- **Target Audience:** Engineering students (B.Tech / B.E.), hobbyists, makers, and innovators across India.
- **Key Stats:** 100+ Projects Completed, 50+ DIY Kits Developed, 500+ Components Cataloged.
- **Status:** Coming Soon — Early Access waitlist currently active.
- **Website:** https://www.theprojectshop.online/
